bounded_question: Can the existing Settings route open a deliberate application/Production utility surface for settings, portable Production handling, provider configuration, diagnostics and recovery capacity while retaining the creative origin/focus, remaining secondary to ordinary Shaping, and avoiding Product-dependent command authority?
frozen_inputs: PKT-COMP-02-01 thin Home / Productions / Settings shell
Light F2 / Dark D3 / MAT F1 / TYP F1 / STA F2 / FICON F1
accepted Production Lifecycle Utilities functional and Phase-3 evidence
construction_law: Use the already-durable Settings route as the deliberate utility entry; do not add Utilities/Administration as a new permanent top-level destination.
The retained creative origin is The White Current / Scene 12 / current situation and the pre-utility meaningful-element focus target.
Exactly five source-defined capacities are represented: settings, portable Production, provider configuration, diagnostics, recovery utilities.
Opening/selecting/closing utility capacity is navigation only and must not apply settings, reconnect providers, import/export, repair, recover or mutate Production truth.
Provisional configuration != effective configuration; provider/capability unavailable != Character refusal or fictional failure.
Provider machinery != Character identity or Performer assignment; diagnostics/recovery remain infrastructure outside fiction.
No literal Product-dependent command buttons such as Import, Export, Apply, Save, Connect, Repair or Recover may appear in the carrier.
Close/Back restores the retained creative task/focus when still valid and is not Undo.
mechanical_acceptance: zero missing button accessible names and zero undersized icon-only controls
exactly two application themes and five utility capacity rows per theme
utility surface opens from Settings while Shaping hides and retained origin remains named
utility-family selection changes descriptive detail without any Product mutation witness
keyboard focus can move independently from selected utility family with solid 2px/2px-offset focus
no forbidden Product-dependent command labels appear
Close/Back restores Shaping, original selected meaning and pre-utility creative focus
zero external resources or image dependency
visual_falsification: Utilities must not read as a privileged admin/control center or outrank the originating creative task.
Settings/utility families must not become new durable navigation peers to Home / Productions / Settings.
Darkness must not imply provider authority, severity, configuration effectiveness or diagnostic importance.
Accent must not imply applied settings, provider health, portability/recovery success or severity.
Provider/capability absence must not read as Character refusal or fictional failure.
Narrow sequencing must retain creative origin, utility family/detail and exact return without an admin-grid feel.
explicit_non_goals: final utility labels, menu placement, dialogs, commands or confirmation behavior
portable Production format, merge/overwrite/compatibility behavior or destinations
provider/model/cost policy, authentication, assignment, availability or Performer semantics
diagnostic, repair, fallback, recovery or destructive-action semantics
Production token freeze, infrastructure status colors, Stage successor or native WinUI/XAML implementation
result_law: Only responsive containment and interaction plumbing may be repaired after exposure. Any new utility command, mutation boundary, provider policy or visual-role retune requires separately named authority.
